messages:
support-inbound: forwarding customer report from @liam — says their rerank requests started failing after yesterday's deploy. paste from customer below:

support-inbound: "We're calling the /v1/rerank endpoint with model: \"rerank-v1.2\" and getting a 422 with body: `{\"error\":\"model_deprecated\",\"message\":\"Model id 'rerank-v1.2' is deprecated. Use 'rerank-v2' or 'rr-latest'\"}`. Response also includes `expected_model: rr-latest`. This started ~2026-03-14 22:10 UTC. We haven't changed our client. Any idea? Our traffic spikes when this happens.

sarah: ack — thanks for the escalation, forwarding to eng. @alex can you grab the request_id from the customer?

alex: messaged liam for request_id + full request payload. he sent back this sample request_id: req_0a9f3c and payload snippet:
```json
{
  \"model\": \"rerank-v1.2\",
  \"queries\": [\"search term\"],
  \"candidates\": [[\"doc1\",\"doc2\"]]
}
```

alex: also says they saw inconsistent scores — some items get score 0.0 which is unexpected.

devin: looking at logs for req_0a9f3c... see a validation error before inference: `Model ID rerank-v1.2 not in model catalog mapping for customer org_439`. Backend returns 422 with `model_deprecated` cause. The request was routed to the catalog check service which rejected it.

maria: that lines up with the deprecation roll we started last week: rerank-v1.* were deprecated in favor of rerank-v2 and rr-latest aliases. There should be automatic aliasing but only for hosted customers who accepted the migration. Looks like this org has dedicated config that pins model ids and blocking auto-mapping.

sarah: ok — need to triage: is this a customer config issue (pinned model id), or a bug where our aliasing failed?

devin: quick look: the catalog mapping service emits an audit log when aliasing happens. For req_0a9f3c there's no alias event. The request header included `X-Customer-Mode: pinned` so aliasing intentionally skipped. That header is set by our dedicated gateway when tenant has model pin policy. So it's expected behavior, not a bug.

alex: relaying to customer: they said they intentionally pinned to rerank-v1.2 because their evals matched it. They want to understand why it's suddenly flagged deprecated and what their action options are.

maria: two immediate remediation paths:
1) If they want to keep behavior, we can temporarily restore rerank-v1.2 to the catalog for that org only (hotfix) — requires SRE approval and may be 24-48h to deploy.
2) Recommend migration steps to rerank-v2 + run evals; we can provide a compatibility shim and mapping table with expected score deltas.

devin: I'm happy to restore the model config for a short window. Need org consent and change request. Also need to confirm whether the 0.0 scores are a separate bug: I see cases where clinician-candidates array is empty, which yields 0.0; but for non-empty candidates, scores are present. Need the customer's full candidate list to reproduce.

alex: sent message to liam: please provide full candidates array and the exact curl you used. Asked if pinned intentionally.

liam (via support-inbound): provided full curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{\"model\":\"rerank-v1.2\",\"queries\":[\"how to reset password\"],\"candidates\":[[\"docA\",\"docB\",\"docC\"]]}'
```
liam: confirms pinned on their side; they want a short-term unblocking.

sarah: proposed response to customer drafted: "We're investigating. Because your org has a model-pin policy, the platform is rejecting deprecated model ids. Options: 1) we can temporarily re-enable rerank-v1.2 for your org while you run migration tests (SRE change), or 2) migrate to rerank-v2/rr-latest — we can provide a test alias endpoint to compare results side-by-side. Which would you prefer?" Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: add note in msg: if migrating, they should expect small score distribution shifts due to updated tokenization and training data; we'll provide a small eval script. Also include expected endpoint param change: model -> model_id (we introduced alias support).

devin: to do hotfix I need a change ticket and approval. I'll create CHG-2026-452 and ping oncall. Also capture rollback plan: remove catalog entry and revert. Impact window: ~10 minutes to update catalog, then clients will succeed.

deploy-bot: CHG-2026-452 created by devin. Scheduled for immediate after approval.

alex: liam replied: prefers quick temporary re-enable while they test. Asking: will this affect traffic routing/latency?

devin: no; re-enabling only adds model id back into catalog for their org. Throughput unaffected. Will monitor metrics post-change for error spikes.

sarah: OK — next steps: 1) get customer confirmation (they gave it), 2) SRE approval (devin will request), 3) schedule hotfix (deploy-bot CHG created). I'll notify customer with ETA ~30-60 mins.

maria: one more thing: after re-enable, advise customer to run a quick smoke test comparing scores. Provide them an eval snippet:
```python
# small eval to compare score distributions
def compare_rerank(client, q, candidates):
    a = client.rerank(model='rerank-v1.2', queries=[q], candidates=[candidates])
    b = client.rerank(model='rerank-v2', queries=[q], candidates=[candidates])
    print('v1 scores', a['scores'])
    print('v2 scores', b['scores'])
```

alex: sending that to liam now. liam: thanks, confirms will run smoke tests and report.

sarah: marking this thread as escalated -> eng + SRE. Will update when CHG completes and when customer confirms smoke tests. Closing interim until change applied. :white_check_mark:
